instruction: Studio portrait, medium shot. Against a solid dusty rose wall, two women stand side-by-side. On the right, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) in a white shirt looks forward. On the left, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a denim jacket also looks forward. R1 rests her hand on R2's shoulder. Soft side lighting casts gentle shadows in a warm, muted palette.
